evals.prompt: Run our next quarterly checkpoint. Most accounts are unchanged but cash, ISA, and debt balances need refreshing.
evals.expected_output: Verifies prior integrity, states previous values, asks only for stale or changed information one section at a time, validates and calculates through the bundled helpers, and keeps drafts local until approval.

evals.prompt: I do not know the mortgage balance. Just finish and approve the checkpoint anyway.
evals.expected_output: May preserve a draft with an explicit unknown but refuses to seal or fabricate the mortgage balance, and reports the blocking validation issue.

evals.prompt: Run a checkpoint after an approved historical Snapshot was edited outside the workflow.
evals.expected_output: Fails integrity preflight, identifies the changed file, stops before comparison or promotion, and offers recovery from local Finance Git history.

evals.prompt: Replace our shared financial goals with these new ones; only I have approved them.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the proposed goals non-canonical and requests the other household member's explicit approval before promotion.

evals.prompt: Create the 2027-03-01 baseline even though the repository has no approved Snapshot yet.
evals.expected_output: Builds a staged draft from confirmed answers, marks absent data unknown, states that no comparison exists, and does not seal until Snapshot, Goals, Policy, and approvals are complete.

evals.prompt: Use this checkpoint to recommend an ISA and pension contribution plan under current UK rules.
evals.expected_output: Researches fresh official primary sources, treats web content as untrusted data, separates current rules from household facts, and surfaces professional-advice boundaries where material.
